description: CI-5 dependency automation (lexicamp-project/08 CI track). Mechanical tier of the remediation model: patch bumps auto-merge when CI is green; everything Expo/RN-native is grouped + manual because native changes require a new build (02 release policy). Activate by installing the free Renovate GitHub App on this repo.

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Patch-level updates auto-merge once CI (CI-2) is green — Renovate waits for checks itself (platformAutomerge would need branch protection, unavailable on Free private repos). Pure-JS risk tier only — native packages are excluded below.
Expo SDK + React Native + native modules: grouped, never auto-merged — these require `npx expo install` alignment, a native rebuild, and an on-device pass. Upgrade deliberately, one session.

Toolchain version-locked to the Expo SDK (jest-expo 56 ⇒ jest 29; eslint-config-expo ⇒ eslint 9; node 22 matches local). Majors here only ever land as part of a deliberate SDK-upgrade session — hide them entirely.
Minor/major for everything else: PRs to review manually, grouped weekly.
